overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a single board member's individually signed email to the zoning board was not a quorum deliberation, so the Board did not deliberate outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside an open meeting through a board member's November 2014 email objecting to a neighbor's variance requests, sent to the zoning board.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not deliberate outside of a meeting and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
